objective: Increase awareness and funding for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
businessContext: A participant-led challenge spread through public nominations and video sharing.
strategy: Combine a visible ritual, public nomination, identity and donation into a low-friction participation loop.
outcomes: The ALS Association reported $115 million raised and commissioned a ten-year impact analysis.
whatWorked: The action was observable, replicable and carried its own invitation mechanism.
Participation connected attention to a concrete donation action.
whatFailed: Viral reach and long-term medical outcomes should not be conflated.
transferConditions: The action is safe, simple, identity-relevant and connected to a credible beneficiary and conversion path.
nonTransferConditions: Do not imitate nomination mechanics without participant meaning, trust and operational capacity.

sources.title: ALS Association 2024 year-end report
sources.methodology: Reports participation, funds raised and commissioned impact analysis.

marketMaturity: Established cause with low public awareness

rights.notes: Only independently written factual metadata and outbound links are redistributed.
